const loop_filter_thresh *lfin = lfi_n->lfthr + *(lfl + step);

import sys, random
def write_y4m(path, w, h, nframes, mode="noise"):
    with open(path,'wb') as f:
        f.write(b"YUV4MPEG2 W%d H%d F30:1 Ip A0:0 C420jpeg\n" % (w, h))
        random.seed(1234)
        for fr in range(nframes):
            f.write(b"FRAME\n")
            Y = bytearray(w*h)
            U = bytearray((w//2)*(h//2))
            V = bytearray((w//2)*(h//2))
            for i in range(w*h):
                x = i % w; y = i // w
                if mode == "noise":
                    Y[i] = random.randrange(256)
                elif mode == "checker":
                    Y[i] = 255 if ((x//4 + y//4) & 1) else 0
                elif mode == "edges":
                    Y[i] = (x*255//w)
            for i in range(len(U)):
                U[i] = random.randrange(256)
                V[i] = random.randrange(256)
            f.write(bytes(Y)); f.write(bytes(U)); f.write(bytes(V))
if __name__ == "__main__":
    write_y4m(sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv)>5 else "noise")
EOF
